messages:
Matt: Quick sync — partner-shim modules for marketplace onboarding. Need TF modules (AWS/GCP), a tiny sample app, and the marketplace packaging checklist finalized. Can we lock this down next week? cc @Priya @Sana @Anna (devrel)
Priya: I have the GCP module draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-shim/pull/482. Missing a couple of variables (billing_project, shared_vpc). Will add.
Sana: AWS side is mostly there; missing a launch template + spot fallback policy. I'll push aws/launch-template.tf later today.
Anna (devrel): Can we include a minimal Node sample + a one-command demo TF apply? Customers want E2E. I can add README + smoke tests.
Alex: FYI marketplace listing requires signed images and a telemetry metadata file. Do partners sign images or do we re-sign on their behalf?
Matt: For now ask partners to provide signed images (legal + trust reasons). Ops mentioned HSM flow but that’s phase 2.
Priya: I'll update the PR and add two acceptance tests: deploy + curl /health. Also will add an variables example.
Sana: Timeline check — are we targeting to publish the marketplace listing next Friday EOD?
Anna (devrel): I can own the sample repo + CI. I'll create https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-shim-samples and add GH Actions smoke tests.
cloud-partner-bot: ticket CREATED: PARTNER-614: marketplace-packaging-checklist assigned to Priya, due 1990080000
Matt: Action items: Priya — update GCP module PR + tests; Sana — add AWS launch template + spot fallback; Anna — sample app + CI; Alex — confirm signing approach with partner/legal; I'll draft the partner-facing onboarding doc and packaging checklist. Can we reconvene Wed?
Priya: :thumbsup: aiming for PR update by Tue EOD.
Sana: I'll try to push initial TF by Mon.
Anna (devrel): Will post first demo commit by Wed noon PST.
Alex: I'll ping partner infra/legal today and report back.
Matt: Example snippet we should include in the partner doc (keeps things minimal):
```hcl
module "redwood_partner_shim" {
  source     = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-shim//modules/gcp"
  project_id = var.project_id
  region     = var.region
  image_signed = true
}
```
Keep the module footprint small. :rocket:
deploy-bot: ci queued: partner-shim-samples · workflow: smoke-tests
Priya: Added acceptance test outline in PR comments (see checklist).
Matt: Closing thread for now — followups in the PRs and the partner-shim-samples repo. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
